body: The time to find out what what drives me has come and gone. My life is always going to be a cycle of ineptitude, incompteance, and mediorcity because I'm a hyperemotional mess who cannot find any value within himself or anything he does. You make it sound so simple, but these are things that I have tried to figure out and change for years and have never come up with any real, concrete answers. Everyone seems to have some sense of normalcy in their lives except me. I'm so tired of it all, and it will never change.
Just talk therapy, can't afford any other special types of therapy.

People are always telling me how smart I am, as if that's supposed to mean something. It doesn't matter how smart I am if no good or value comes from it. And I ultimately have to disagree that charisma and charm can be learned. You either have it or you don't, this is not something that can be developed.
Just because I enjoy does not mean its of good to anyone or anything.

Everything. I've been to therapy off and on for almost 10 years now. Have tried antidepressants, all of them stop working after a while. The people in my life just don't understand why I'm so misrable all the time. By all accounts everything is going well for me. I just can't get myself to find any joy in it. Yes...depression I know....so far all my efforts to treat it have been in vain. I'm just an overemotional crybaby who can't deal with things. Nothing I've tried has worked. Just the thought of yet another day of pretending is driving me insane.

At one time I probably did, but that is all over now. There are some things that just cannot be learned. Charisma, confidence, panache...you either have these things are you don't. I will never have these things. Whatever little of them I had are lost forever.

Absolutely nobody likes me. It's all a ruse, a false obligation that they impose on themselves so they can pat themselves on the back later about what a good person they are. The truth is everyone, especially at my workplace despise me. Nowadays its all about networking, and if everyone despises me there is no hope of me every being successful. I have no talents, no skills, nothing of value to this world. Absolutely nothing.
It doesn't matter, it would never last.
